name: Eochaid Iúil

attributes.attribute: a fairy queen whom some texts name his wife

sources: Monaghan, Patricia. The Encyclopedia of Celtic Mythology and Folklore. Checkmark Books, 2008.
text: Eochaid Iúil is a god of the Otherworld. In some texts he stands as the husband of the fairy queen Fand. He belongs to the shadowy band of rulers who sit beyond the mortal world. His name is one of several borne by the Eochaid figures of Irish myth. The texts that pair him with Fand set him among the sovereign powers of the hidden realm.
